title: Who plays on this device (user://profiles.json)
description: The device's "Who is playing?" roster and the parent PIN. Never uploaded as a file: the sync add-on sends the profile list (id, nickname, picture, guest) to PUT /v1/devices/{dev}/profiles. The PIN hash never leaves the device.

nickname.description: Up to 12 characters. No real names asked for.

picture.description: A picture id from the game's set (Acorn: art/heroes/<id>.png).

guest.description: Plays and saves locally, never syncs.

child.description: The family's child id once paired; null before.

pin.description: The parent PIN (4 digits) as a salted hash, or null when none is set.
